The cabin in the woods is a cozy new place that was introduced in the full release of the game.

The player may sleep inside (and save the game) as there is a bed available.

== Unlocking ==
There are 2 ways to unlock this area:

* After you repair the [[stone bridge]] that leads to the [[swamp]], you follow the road until it ends. You'll find a path that's [[Blockage|blocked]] by some rocks. You need to clear that path and go straight north.
* Follow the path north of the [[graveyard]] (or north-west of [[Sweet Home|your home]]), into the [[Forest near the river|forest]]. There's a path that's [[Blockage|blocked]] by some rocks. Once you clear that path, go north-west again, following the [[river]], there will be a small footbridge that allows you to cross the [[river]].

== Mining ==
There are five infinite resources available for [[mining]] in this area (from west to east):

* One big [[iron ore deposit]], which gives {{Item|Iron block}} when mined.
* One big [[stone quarry]], which gives {{Item|Stone block}} when mined. You will need {{Item|Wood wedge|4}} for two blocks. You can also employ [[zombie]]s here.
* One big [[marble quarry]] (has to be built in advance), to allow gathering of {{Item|Marble block}}. You will need {{Item|Wood wedge|4}} for two blocks. You can also employ [[zombie]]s here.
* One combined {{Item|Iron ore}} and {{Item|Coal}} deposit, where you can set up a [[zombie ore mine]] as soon as you've unlocked [[zombie]]s.
* One big [[coal deposit]], which gives 20-30 {{Item|Coal}} when mined.

== Workstations ==
The workbench for placing all the workstations is located in the northwest corner of the workyard. For most stations, you have to unlock the related [[technologies|technology]] first.
